project.name: Budget-SID
project.summary: Budget allocation plus a light SID generative-recall experiment on Amazon Beauty.
project.summary_zh: 预算分配，加上一条轻量的 Semantic ID 生成式召回实验。不把 TIGER 论文的模型创新算作本仓库的贡献。

stages.name: MiniLM
stages.detail: Frozen 384-d item vectors. FLAN-T5-XL was not used.

stages.name: SID
stages.detail: RQ-KMeans codes plus the TIGER dedup digit. Generator num_hierarchies=4.

stages.name: tiger_train_flat
stages.detail: Early stop. Best checkpoint checkpoint_epoch=000_step=018800.ckpt. Best val/recall@5 ≈ 0.059.

stages.name: fixed-beam infer
stages.detail: top_k 20/40/60 all exit 0, about 22363 rows each. Finished 12:06 / 12:07 / 12:09 Asia/Shanghai.

stages.name: benefit-aware stop-gate
stages.detail: Request-level benefit-aware ΔNDCG@20 budget stop-gate is not connected to GRID tiger_inference outputs. Fixed-beam only.

instance.note: Josepha asked for no auto-shutdown after finish. Scripts log SKIP_SHUTDOWN and do not power the machine off.

still_open: Wire request-level ΔNDCG@20 benefit prediction to GRID tiger_inference outputs
